description_en: Adds a phone number by calling AddPhoneNumber
name: AddPhoneNumber

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center instance to which you want to add the phone number
parameters.help_zh: 待添加电话号码的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The purpose of the phone number. Valid values:

Inbound: inbound calls only.
Outboung: outbound calls only.
Bidirection: both inbound and outbound calls.

If the phone number is a 400 number, set this parameter to Inbound only
parameters.help_zh:
该电话号码的用途。取值：呼入（Inbound），呼出（Outboung），已经同时用于呼入和呼出（Bidirection）。

如果传入号码为400号码，该值只能传入Inbound
parameters.name: usage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact flow to associate with the phone number
parameters.help_zh: 和电话号码绑定的联系流ID
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

PhoneNumber.description_en: The information about the newly added phone number
PhoneNumber.description_zh: 新添加的电话号码的信息

AllowOutbound.description_en:
Indicates whether outbound calls are allowed. The result depends on:

The carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
The call center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) Configure the carrier settings so that callers hear a prompt tone when dialing the number. 2) Do not associate the number with a contact flow IVR. However, this approach is not recommended
AllowOutbound.description_zh:
是否允许外呼，结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不绑定联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

ContactFlow.description_en: The contact flow IVR associated with the phone number
ContactFlow.description_zh: 电话号码所连接的联系流IVR

ContactFlowDescription.description_en: The description of the contact flow

ContactFlowId.description_en: The unique ID of the contact flow, which is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
ContactFlowId.description_zh: 联系流唯一ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

ContactFlowName.description_en: The name of the contact flow. The name must be unique within an instance
ContactFlowName.description_zh: 联系流名称，在一个实例内名称不能重复

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the call center instance to which the contact flow belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 联系流所归属的呼叫中心实例

Type.description_en: The flow type, as defined by ContactFlowType
Type.description_zh: 流程类型, 定义来自于ContactFlowType

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the call center instance to which the phone number belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 电话号码所归属的呼叫中心实例ID

PhoneNumberDescription.description_en: The description of the phone number

PhoneNumberId.description_en: The phone number ID, which is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
PhoneNumberId.description_zh: 电话号码ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

RemainingTime.description_en: The remaining call time for the test number. Unit: minutes
RemainingTime.description_zh: 测试号码剩余的通话时间。单位为分钟

TestOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the phone number is a test number

Trunks.description_en: The number of trunks for the phone number, which indicates the number of concurrent calls supported. The data is provided by the carrier
Trunks.description_zh: 电话号码的中继数量，即可同时支持几路通话，数据来源于大于

Usage.description_en:
The purpose of the phone number. Valid values:

Inbound: inbound calls only.
Outbound: outbound calls only.
Bidirection: both inbound and outbound calls.

The values above are defined by the PhoneNumberType enumeration.

The result depends on:

The carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
The call center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) Configure the carrier settings so that callers hear a prompt tone when dialing the number. 2) Do not associate the number with a contact flow IVR. However, this approach is not recommended
Usage.description_zh:
电话号码的用途。取值：呼入（Inbound），呼出（Outbound），已经同时用于呼入和呼出（Bidirection）上述值由枚举类型PhoneNumberType定义。

该值的结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不连接人和联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
